reviews.text: Your kind words truly make us happy! Our team works hard every day to provide attentive and professional service. Knowing that you appreciate our work is the best reward. Thank you for your trust!

The girls are all kind and professional.
Pocho came out looking new. Thank you 💕 …

The grooming service was extremely expensive and of terrible quality. The staff charged me extra because the dog had knots in his fur. Honestly, if the dog didn't have knots, there would be no reason to take him to the groomer. This request is absurd.

After the service, I was told you were doing me a "favor" because instead of charging me an extra €30 for the excessive amount of knots, I was asked for "only" an extra €15. This behavior is unacceptable and seems like a scam.

The service is absolutely not worth the price I paid (€110). Furthermore, my dog ​​was clipped very unevenly, with obvious and uneven marks. Now I have to wait for his fur to grow back.

For these reasons, I will never return and I absolutely will not recommend the service to anyone.
I'm sorry, but they're not competent. The diagnosis was completely wrong. A three-minute visit costed 48 euros. I'm not going to question the price, but at least I'd like to have some valid answers.

Everyone is very kind, from the reception staff, to the vets we met, to the dog groomer. I've been taking my dog ​​there for a few years now, and it's a go-to place, and I highly recommend it for its professionalism and courtesy.

After visiting several clinics, we finally figured out why my little Tom is pulling out his fur. Dr. Pellegrino is very helpful, kind, and professional. He analyzed everything he needed to do. When my Tom started pulling out his fur again, he ran more tests, and we discovered that the problem was also psychological. The recovery process is long, but the results are noticeable. Tom is no longer a crazy spinning top. I'll be bringing my other three cats home.

I brought my small dog for a grooming service (bath and nail trim). The appointment was scheduled for 12:00 PM, and I was kept. Given the usual time for this service (45-60 minutes), I asked the staff to kindly keep the dog until 1-1:15 PM since a friend of mine would be picking him up at that time. They said no problem. At 12:28 PM, my phone rang saying the dog was ready, which was unusual since it usually takes longer. I explained to the staff member what we had previously agreed upon. At 1:15 PM, my phone rang, telling me to go pick up the dog because they couldn't keep him due to multiple appointments. In the meantime, I contacted my friend, who told me he had just stopped by to pick up the animal. When my friend called to ask for an explanation of this whole situation, the lady on the phone started yelling, saying they'd had the animal since 11:30, or two hours (which wasn't true), and that they didn't have time to waste with rude people because they WORK. Aside from the rudeness, which is no small thing, I paid €37 for a dog that smells of damp because it wasn't dried properly. I don't think it's possible to provide a good service in twenty minutes. A truly terrible experience.

Terrifying experience. Absolutely avoid.
My family and I waited a long time before writing this review, but we felt it was right to make our experience public so we could tell our story.
We took our dog to the clinic for some growths all over her body. The clinic's vet suggested removing them, so we followed his advice.
What can I say? The doctor, clearly incompetent, didn't even have the bright idea to shave the surrounding areas before the surgery (hair removal is a preliminary step to any type of surgery). And of course, the wounds (untreated) took a long time to heal because they were always full of hair and infected, causing my dog ​​a lot of pain.

I wish I could end my review here, but this wasn't the only negative experience we've had.

Shortly afterward, we took our dog to the same vet for a persistent cough and other symptoms. The doctor began prescribing medication, but despite her cough getting worse, he did nothing else.
Literally months went by without any answers, but the worst part was that he didn't perform any tests.
I can understand a vet having difficulty diagnosing, but not one who doesn't perform adequate diagnostic tests.
All this until the day our little girl became so ill that she had to be taken to an animal emergency room, where, with an X-ray (the most basic test a vet should perform in this circumstance), they diagnosed her with a lung tumor.

We are truly disappointed with this clinic and the incompetence of its staff, and we can't help but believe that perhaps, if we had listened to our concerns months earlier, we would have gained more time with her.
For these reasons, it's not a place I recommend.
Unfortunately we had to take our friend Rocky there and we received courtesy, professionalism and great love for our four-legged friends, they were very good.

I was truly impressed by the helpfulness and kindness of the entire staff!
The receptionists were welcoming and ready to help me manage a very delicate situation. Thanks also to Dr. Feltri for his availability and cooperation.

Thank you so much everyone!

I highly recommend
Thank you for your positive feedback! Pet welfare and owner satisfaction are our top priorities.

HORRIBLE experience. Mother brought our 2 dogs for blood tests and they treated her terribly. The appointment was booked at 11:30 and they received her at 12. So far, everything is fine (even though there was no one there before her). The dogs did the tests they had already scheduled, which would have cost €150 each for a total of €300. When my mother goes to pay, they tell her that it is €480, which is an increase in the price over the course of a month. My mother asks for explanations and is treated terribly even by a "shop assistant" who could have been her daughter. She yelled at her and no one did anything. Rude staff, excessive costs, shoddy work. Highly not recommended.

Worst experience with a vet I've ever had.
I don't know if they're better with dogs, but I arrived there with a former stray with stomach and urinary problems, but he had already been vaccinated and treated for parasites. Needless to say, after spending about €500, I found the solution myself, and it worked (a simple lactic acid bacteria, €35, less than 10% of what they asked me for doing nothing). The vet, probably not very competent, even answered my questions with a smugness. A horrifying experience, highly inadvisable. You can find excellent ones just a short distance away.

I took my Ragdoll to this clinic for the first time for a haircut. I found the receptionists very kind and explained the price list and the treatment to me. The groomer proved to be very skilled; the kitten never had any mange or showed any signs of discomfort, not even when she had her nails trimmed. Once she got home, the cat didn't seem to feel uncomfortable, which I find very comforting. It was a great experience; my cat must have appreciated the treatment; the girls were very courteous and professional. We'll be back!
Your kind words truly make us happy! Our team works hard every day to provide attentive and professional service. Knowing that you appreciate our work is the best reward. Thank you for your trust!
Competent and professional staff.
We are happy to know that our efforts are appreciated and that you had a positive experience with us.
The diagnosis was not precise, we had to have it redone by an ultrasound specialist.

They were able to correct a mistake made by another vet, and the kitten is back to playing and running like before. They also discovered she had osteomyelitis and were able to intervene in time to manage it. Kind and professional.

I have been bringing my dog here for grooming and vet visits for the last three years. Prices are reasonable and the staff is friendly. Make reservations in advance, especially for grooming because they book up in advance.
We took our Lagotto Ray for a grooming session, which was performed by a truly talented person, Sabrina. I've never had such a perfect grooming! Thank you for your kindness and skill.
I'm happy with this clinic. It's as welcoming as a small office, but it has many doctors and a lot of equipment. Fair prices. Extended hours. I recommend it.

Sabrina's grooming was a fantastic experience for my dog! Sabrina is highly professional and attentive to detail. My dog ​​came home smelling great and with a beautiful coat. The environment is clean and welcoming, and you can see how much she cares about the animals' well-being. Impeccable service and excellent value. I highly recommend her to all dog owners!

I took my dog ​​from boarding to be groomed because the owner requested it. Of course, I knew they wouldn't give me an appointment right away, but luckily I found one the next day. To cut a long story short, I was told over the phone that the cost would be around €100 (€75 wash + €25 de-wooling + €20 trim) for a large, long-haired dog weighing 30-35 kg, in this case a female flat-coated retriever.
In an hour and a half, she was ready. I commented, "Woow, they're so quick!" Then I understood why. The dog had simply had a few tangled hairballs removed, nothing had been trimmed, and at this point I'm not sure if she'd had a de-wooling, because she was exactly the same as when she came in, and at least smelled nice. Obviously, there was no ear cleaning, no ear cleaning, no nail trimming, and not even the requested hygienic clipping because the dog was older and made a mess when she peed.
The total cost was different from the estimate, for some reason. "Send the invoice by email?" "Yes, thanks!" The invoice never arrived! (I mentioned that I needed it to show to the owner.) What can I say? It's a no-go!
Dr. Sara Carminati was very professional and kind.
I've been waiting for my health plan refund for a month...don't reply to emails...I'll wait a few more days and then I'll take action!!

My first visit to this facility because my cat's trusted vet was closed for vacation.
I called 15 days in advance, made an appointment, arranged the FeLV booster …
Dr. Pellegrini is helpful and competent, highly recommended.
